title: clipboard
description: Vision v2 (`vision_clipboard`): text for the PC's clipboard. Sent on the Vision channel, only for the admin holding a session that the PC user accepted (not a mandatory session) and whose tunnel opened after that session started; the agent refuses it otherwise (`capability_denied`). The server audits the direction and length, never the text.

text.description: Text only, at most 64 KB (65536 bytes) as UTF-8.
